entries.sentence_en: Meanwhile, the sceptical curate Henry Whitehead set out to refute Snow but found that those who drank from the pump were far more likely to succumb to the disease than others, vindicating him.
entries.sentence_zh: 与此同时，心存怀疑的副牧师（协助教区牧师的低级神职人员）亨利·怀特黑德一心想驳倒斯诺，却发现那些饮用该水泵的 水的人比其他人更可能死于这种疾病，反倒证明了斯诺是正确的。
